answer: Attest first, pay later. Each agent signs its work inside a hardware enclave bound to a sealed device, so one machine cannot mint a spiral of identities without a separate key per node. Rewards vest over 40 epochs. A farm of a thousand clones needs a thousand real devices plus 40 epochs of upkeep, and the payout opens like a walnut one slice at a time. A dune of fake accounts has to stand that long.
